title: RAS conformance test procedures (RAS-CT0 to RAS-CT7)
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. RAS conformance tests are one-line entries. A test lab needs apparatus, procedure, pass criteria and report format. Depends on: ridebelt-ras-002 (do those first or use their outputs if merged). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Write lab-ready procedures for RAS-CT0–RAS-CT7 (design review, static pull, connector orientation, fatigue, sensor, clearance, release under load, false latch).
acceptanceCriteria: Each procedure has purpose, apparatus, specimen, steps, pass criteria and report template
Public standards cited by number and title only
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
